name: security-and-hardening
tagline_zh: 当你的代码要接用户输入、登录或第三方API时，别裸奔。这个技能会像老中医把脉，找出漏洞并开出加固药方。
tagline_en: When your code touches user input, auth, or third-party APIs, don't go naked. This skill diagnoses.
desc_en: Hardens code against vulnerabilities. Use when handling user input, authentication, data storage, or external integrations. Use when building any feature that accepts untrusted data, manages user sessions, or interacts with third-party services.
why_zh: 它不只是扫描，而是逐行审查数据流，给出可落地的修复代码，比一般lint工具更懂攻击面。
why_en: It doesn't just scan—it traces data flows line-by-line and provides actionable fixes, understanding attack surfaces better than.
